affordance_in_statement: Your specific objective is to ensure that a critical subset of t clusters ... are fully integrated; You may freely involve non-critical clusters in the merges if doing so results in a lower total cost; 1 ≤ t ≤ 10

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Treats the task as a modified Kruskal or terminal-MST problem, missing that an optimal solution may use non-critical Steiner vertices and that locally cheapest unions do not generally minimize the connecting subgraph
Uses ordinary Kruskal after sorting edges by weight, which constructs a global minimum spanning forest rather than the minimum-cost subgraph connecting only the critical clusters

recommended_edit: No valid edit can defeat both surviving correct solutions while preserving the stated task. Any edit that removes arbitrary non-critical intermediate clusters or the small-terminal Steiner structure changes the problem rather than re-presenting it.
regression_risk: Any attempt to forbid or obscure non-critical intermediate clusters would alter the task and could make the already-defeated MST/Kruskal approaches appear correct.
